messages:
tariq: quick heads-up — ran a long tail profile on the latest allocator + reuse patch. seeing a persistent stall cluster during buffer handoff between activation scratchpad and logits pool, plus a correlated spike in OOMs when KV writes overlap eviction. flamegraph + timeline attached (link)
anya: can you paste the timeline snippet? is this the handoff path where we do: grab_slot -> memcpy -> release_slot? :thinking:
tariq: yep. simplified trace:
```
[STREAM A] alloc(activation, 12MB) -> compute
[STREAM B] kv_write -> alloc(logits, 8MB) -> compute
[STREAM A] finish -> async memcpy(scratchpad->logits)
freelist_release(slot)  <-- races with kv_write alloc
```
Result: freelist sometimes hands out partially-stale slots, forcing small re-allocs and fragmentation. p99 memory peaks + OOMs when batch concurrency > 6.
sam: sounds like a classic handoff-orchestration race. two quick ideas:
- make handoff two-phase: stage -> fence -> commit (use cudaEventRecord + stream synchronize on commit)
- make freelist_release atomic with a version counter (hazard counters) so allocers ignore in-flight frees
both add small latency but remove races.
jess: both ok but latency is sensitive. can we gate the stronger synchronization behind heuristics? e.g. only on batch_size >= 8 or when free_pool_size < threshold. also add metric tag: handoff_sync=on/off so we can A/B.
deploy-bot: canary job started: allocator-handoff-fence v2 on 3 GPU canaries (run id: canary-2026-03-18-16)
anya: nice. also consider a lightweight deferred-free: instead of immediate returned slot, put it in a per-stream retired list and only merge into global freelist on a fence or when retired_list length > N. avoids atomic ops for common path.
tariq: ran quick canary results — after enabling retired-list + commit-fence for cross-stream handoffs:
- OOM rate down ~85% on the stress harness (seq=1024, kv-warm)
- p99 latency up ~6ms on average (median unchanged)
- heap fragmentation heatmap shows fewer small holes but more short-lived small allocations
proposal: keep retired-list + commit-fence for cross-stream, and run a freelist-compaction sweep in background when GPU idle.
sam: background compaction is fine but we need an idle detector (gpu_util < 5% for 200ms). otherwise compaction will fight normal allocs. also consider opportunistic eager-free for logits buffers (they're cheap to reallocate) and reserve a tiny scratchpad bump allocator for single-batch ephemeral stuff.
jess: OK — owners: tariq implement retired-list + fence + metrics; sam add idle-detector + background compaction; anya add e2e perf test (kv concurrency matrix) and create dashboard tiles for OOM-rate, handoff-latency, freelist-depth. target: ship to canary cluster next week and ramp if OOMs remain low.
tariq: I'll open the PR with tests and a small perf harness (1k reqs, bs=8/16 seq=512/1024). linking draft here: https://git.internal/r/allocator/handoff-draft
anya: thanks — let's also add a short-run with kernel-selection stress (vary kernel stride and seq) to ensure the fence doesn't block optimized kernels. jess: sounds good. i'll own the rollout timeline and post updates in #eng-runtime.
